directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Current official operator e-mobility page and its still-linked m.charge tariff sheet.
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The current official page explicitly labels the linked values as m.charge charging-card tariffs. The sheet also mixes Ladenetz, roaming and high-price-provider categories, so these values are not promoted to a station-level ad-hoc tariff for the operator's own EVSEs.

reason: A current official e-mobility page exists and still links the 2023 m.charge card tariff, but no current public direct-payment/ad-hoc price or EVSE-level checkout was found. Contract/card values are retained only as evidence and are not extrapolated.
nextEvidenceNeeded: A current official ad-hoc/direct-payment checkout tied to a Stadtwerke Mühlheim EVSE, or an operator tariff sheet explicitly mapping its own stations to the applicable direct price.
